sql:
SELECT
  t.name AS tenant_name,
  s.carrier,
  count(*) AS shipment_count,
  round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) over (partition by t.name), 1) AS pct_of_tenant_shipments,
  round(avg(extract(epoch from (s.delivered_at - s.shipped_at)) / 86400.0) filter (where s.delivered_at is not null and s.shipped_at is not null), 1) AS avg_delivery_days,
  round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where s.delivered_at is not null and s.shipped_at is not null and s.delivered_at - s.shipped_at <= interval '3 days')
        / nullif(count(*) filter (where s.delivered_at is not null and s.shipped_at is not null), 0), 1) AS pct_delivered_within_3_days
FROM shipments s
JOIN tenants t ON t.id = s.tenant_id
WHERE t.name IN ('Marrowby & Vane', 'Studio Vrij', 'Cragsley Outfitters')
  AND s.shipped_at >= timestamp '2025-01-01'
  AND s.shipped_at < timestamp '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY t.name, s.carrier
ORDER BY t.name, shipment_count DESC
